howto.what: 装好后，Claude 可以连接你的 Microsoft Teams 账户，在团队频道、群聊或私聊中收发消息。
howto.when: 当你运行此技能或要求 Claude 设置 Teams 集成时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置 Microsoft Teams 集成。
say.note: 开始自动配置 Teams 连接。

say.text: 将 Claude 添加到我的 Teams 频道。
say.note: 创建并安装 Teams 机器人。

say.text: 我需要通过 Teams 与 Claude 聊天。
say.note: 机器人会在你的 Teams 中上线。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can connect to your Microsoft Teams account and send/receive messages in team channels, group chats, or direct messages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run this skill or ask Claude to set up Teams integration.

say_en.text: Set up Microsoft Teams integration for me.
Add Claude to my Teams channel.
say_en.note: Creates and installs the Teams bot.

say_en.text: I want to chat with Claude via Teams.
say_en.note: The bot will go online in your Teams.
